sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fleet Route Optimization and Real-Time Telematics SaaS

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (with residual French/civil law influence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive BIT or DTAA currently in force; Vanuatu maintains limited bilateral tax information exchange arrangements and general foreign investment facilitation frameworks

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (Act No. 15 of 1992), as amended by International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 21 of 2016; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2017; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) Rules and Regulations; VFSC Regulatory Directives on Beneficial Ownership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of beneficial owner passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or bank in resident jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate KYC package for non-individual shareholders (certificate of incorporation, register of directors, register of shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or competent authority in shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth declaration with supporting evidence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all identified ultimate beneficial owners, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit sanctions list, UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/60-day list, EU consolidated sanctions list, and global PEP databases such as Dow Jones Risk & Compliance and World-Check. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any PEP match, high-risk jurisdiction linkage, or adverse media result.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Company Name Reservation and E-Registration Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be registered in the Latin alphabet. English, French, and Bislama names are acceptable, with an English transcription for non-Latin names. The name must include a permitted corporate suffix under the International Companies Act, such as 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered entity in Vanuatu.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An applicant may apply for a one-time 14-day extension of a reserved name by written request before expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal to the VFSC Registrar within 21 days of the rejection notice, addressing the grounds of refusal and attaching the original name reservation receipt. If the Registrar sustains the refusal, the applicant may pursue judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not acceptable as the sole registered office. A licensed Vanuatu registered agent must maintain a physical registered office address in Vanuatu. Remote management of the International Company from outside Vanuatu is permissible.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk (approx. 5% annual likelihood) for a standard low-risk telematics SaaS company with no domestic Vanuatu trading activity; VFSC and VFIU retain risk-based inspection rights under the AML/CFT Act.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and physical registered office service — first year
Beneficial ownership disclosure filing and internal UBO register maintenance — first year
KYC/AML customer due diligence pack preparation and PEP/sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance service provider / corporate services firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of identity and address documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and relevant consular authority

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External legal pre-incorporation due diligence review
Bank reference verification and source-of-funds cross-check
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank's standard service charge or service provider benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 14, 18 and 26 (incorporation, memorandum, registered office, registered agent, directors and secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with VFSC Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The Memorandum states the authorised share capital; no escrow account or capital deposit is required, and subscriber shares may be issued before or after incorporation against a board-approved subscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial subscribers to the Memorandum of Association do hereby accept the subscription for 100 ordinary common shares of the International Company's no-par-value share capital, effective immediately. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be fixed at the address of the Company's licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that said agent and company secretary be and are hereby appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that each initial director named in the Consent to Act is appointed to office, and the directors are authorized to open corporate bank accounts and execute all documents necessary for the development and delivery of the fleet logistics telematics SaaS platform.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – ePortal Name Reservation Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the VFSC ePortal after conducting an availability search. The proposed name must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not infringe on existing International Companies or prohibited trademarks. Once the name is reserved, the reservation is valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: VFSC Form IC-NAME (Reservation of Company Name)
Certified passport copy of the ultimate beneficial owner/applicant
Letter of engagement from licensed VFSC registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity, the registered agent may re-file with a revised name or provide trademark consent; a refusal is cured by resubmission within 5 business days without additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association Drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent in association with subscribers (licensed by VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare M&A in the statutory form, incorporating provisions on share capital, investor rights, permitted activities and registered office address. Execute M&A by subscribers and have the registered agent certify the execution.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (two originals)
Subscriber consent and share subscription form
Registered office address consent from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC registry counsel identifies a nonconforming clause, execute amended M&A at the agent's office; the resubmission is processed under the existing file within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Statutory Forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – Registration Counter / Online Corporate Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit executed M&A, Form IC-1, Form IC-2 (Directors) and Form IC-3 (Secretary) to VFSC together with the registered agent certificate. The registered agent will confirm that the company will comply with the International Companies Act and Anti-Money Laundering Rules. Submit digitally via the VFSC portal.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in original
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query, the registered agent cures by supplementing the requested statutory declaration or amended form within 14 days; if the file becomes inactive, the company may be re-incorporated simultaneously without penalty because no business has yet commenced.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Office – Treasury (by SWIFT or telegraphic transfer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon pro-forma invoice generated from step 3, effect payment in United States dollars or Vanuatu vatu to the VFSC designated bank account, including the application reference. The registered agent supplies wire proof and cover letter.
required_dossiers: Cover letter from registered agent identifying the company name and task_id
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of an unallocated payment, provide the SWIFT remittance advice and VFSC settlement team reconciles within two business days; no late fee is applied if proof is dated before the applicable threshold.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Registration Deliverables
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After successful registration, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles. The registered agent retrieves these and transmits them to subscribers together with the registered office notification.
required_dossiers: Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical defect in the company number, name or date, submit Form IC-10 to VFSC with the defective document; reissue is completed within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Tax Regime Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks in Vanuatu (e.g. BSP, ANZ, BRED) and Vanuatu Tax and Customs Authority for VAT registration if local establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account for international operations by providing certified corporate documents and beneficial ownership declarations. A non-resident International Company not carrying on exempt business in Vanuatu does not require a domestic business license; register for VAT only if the company makes taxable supplies inside Vanuatu, otherwise no VAT or income tax filing is required.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified M&A
Board resolution on opening bank account
Bank-specific beneficial owner forms and source-of-funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank invokes enhanced due diligence, provide notarized corporate register and signed declaration of beneficial ownership; if refused, the registered agent will redirect to a second tier bank with a simplified procedure within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual Maintenance, Statutory Registers and Registered Agent Continuation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following incorporation, maintain the register of shareholders, directors and secretary at the registered office. File the annual return with the registered agent; no audited financial statements are required for an International Company under the Act.
required_dossiers: Notice of change if any director or secretary changes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an annual return is missed, a late-filing penalty becomes payable; remedy is to submit late fee plus filing at the VFSC counter, with reinstatement possible if the company is struck off.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licensing board is engaged for intangible software services. The Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives retains jurisdiction for physical establishments but is not engaged for this SaaS-only scope.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no physical factory or operating permit required for cloud-based logistics dispatch software. If the company later opens a local service office in Port Vila, it must obtain a Domestic Business License under the Business License Act.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, part of the Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no EIA Registration or environmental impact statement required because the company performs office-based digital software development with no land development, industrial discharge or polluting installations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the software activity; the sole environmental obligation is to dispose of office waste through municipal collection and comply with any generator noise/emission regulation if backup power equipment is installed, aligned with Vanuatu Waste Management and Pollution Control Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire clearance: Obtain a certificate of compliance from the Vanuatu National Fire Service for the rented office occupancy before employee access. Structural and occupational clearance: Have the leased premises assessed for safe equipment loads and workplace compliance under the Vanuatu Occupational Health and Safety Act [Cap. 67], including fire extinguishers, first-aid kits and adequate rest facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://customs.gov.vu; TIN/VAT registration administered via VRC e-Service; company registration administered by Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned entity: (1) incorporate as an International Company (IC) through a VFSC-licensed registered agent, obtaining a Certificate of Incorporation and statutory registers; (2) apply to VRC for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) only if the entity carries on a taxable activity in Vanuatu, using Form VAT-1; an IC that conducts no domestic supply, has no Vanuatu physical establishment, and derives income exclusively from offshore business is not obliged to obtain a TIN because Vanuatu levies no national income tax; (3) obtain a municipal Business Licence only if physically operating a business in Vanuatu, which an IC is generally prohibited from doing; (4) if importing goods or equipment into Vanuatu, the importer must hold a TIN and register with Customs for clearance purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (International Company zero-tax regime): Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, inheritance tax, gift tax, or withholding tax on ICs; the only indirect tax exposure is VAT on taxable imports and local taxable supplies, plus stamp duty on instruments relating to land situated in Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, transparent-entity, or hybrid-mismatch elections exist under Vanuatu law because there is no corporate income tax regime; entities below the VAT registration threshold may voluntarily elect to register under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2014 to recover input VAT, and taxable suppliers may elect to apply the simplified invoicing rules; Vanuatu has no tax treaty network, so treaty-based hybrid planning is unavailable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 2014, administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover for suppliers of goods; VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover for suppliers of services; voluntary registration is permitted for businesses below the thresholds; non-resident digital service suppliers may be subject to registration or reverse-charge obligations when supplying services to Vanuatu-resident businesses.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping regime is in force in Vanuatu; registered taxpayers must issue prescribed VAT invoices or simplified invoices under the VAT Act and file monthly VAT returns with the VRC, retaining source records for audit; customs declarations are processed through Vanuatu's ASYCUDA World single-window system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (1) exported goods where legal title passes to a non-resident and the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within a prescribed period; and (2) services supplied to a non-resident for the direct use and economic benefit of the non-resident outside Vanuatu, including offshore B2B logistics-fleet telematics and SaaS subscriptions, provided no Vanuatu-resident person receives the benefit; the supplier must obtain and retain evidential documentation of export or offshore use, and zero-rated supplies entitle the supplier to full credit for attributable input VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CED) lodged in ASYCUDA World and endorsed by Vanuatu Customs
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or endorsed courier receipt evidencing physical export movement
Commercial invoice and executed service agreement evidencing supply to a non-resident and offshore use
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103 evidencing settlement from the foreign counterparty
Telematics/SaaS usage records and server-access logs demonstrating that services were consumed outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC audit powers allow reversal of unsupported zero-rated claims with VAT, interest, and penalties up to 150% of the evaded tax, and criminal prosecution of directors under the VAT Act sections 67 to 69; false Customs declarations attract seizure of goods, fines, and imprisonment under the Customs Act [Cap 71]; Vanuatu imposes no statutory exchange-control repatriation deadline, so the 180-day period functions as a banking/AML compliance convention and documentary expectation rather than a domestic clawback trigger; retrospectively falsified documentation may also result in deregistration, public naming by VRC, and liability under anti-money-laundering legislation administered by the VFSC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 60]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses and supervises banks and financial service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu is an IMF Article VIII member and maintains current-account convertibility: longitudinal subscription, royalty, and service payments may be made without prior central bank approval. Capital-account transactions are reportable but not prohibited; inward capital increases into a non-resident International Company are allowed through an authorized dealer, although the receiving bank may require an internal approval mandate above VUV 10,000,000. Conversion of trade-value receipts into VUV is not obligatory; the Vatu floats and is not blocked for legitimate corporate flows. Profit-remittance hurdles are evidentiary, not statutory: an exempted Vanuatu IC can distribute dividends to non-resident shareholders with zero withholding tax, but the distributing bank requires a board resolution declaring the dividend, a current share register entry, an updated VFSC certificate of good standing, and a signed copy of the IC's exempt-status confirmation from the registered agent before initiating the SWIFT wire.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory export surrender ratio for a non-resident International Company. For a Vanuatu resident exporter, full proceeds must be repatriated to Vanuatu through an RBV-licensed authorized dealer within 180 days of negotiation of the invoice; no VUV conversion is required and the proceeds may be retained in foreign currency if the exporter can demonstrate a balance-sheet justification. For the VU IC engaged in logistics SaaS, export proceeds consist of cross-border telematics subscription fees; the company should evidence repatriation by monthly SWIFT GPI sweeps from its PSP or settlement bank, and must retain invoices and purpose codes for five years in order to satisfy an authorized dealer's exchange-control reporting obligation. The statutory default of 180 days applies only to residents; the IC is treated as non-resident and may maintain 100% foreign-currency balances offshore without surrender.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operating Account / Capital Escrow Account
Capital Escrow Account / VUV Resident Settlement Account
Retail / Payroll operating account only; weak appetite for non-resident IC

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium — conditionally feasible. A Vanuatu International Company is not statutorily barred from maintaining an account with a non-resident EMI, but the RBV's exchange-control practice expects all resident-sourced settlements to pass through an authorized dealer. Where the IC is truly non-resident, an offshore EMI can be used as a collection-only sweep account for Stripe/PSP clearings; however, major low-cost EMIs often reject shell or economic-substance-light entities, and correspondent banks route funds only if underlying KYC files show shareholders and beneficial owners. Clearance into the primary VU bank is cleanest via an SWIFT MT103/GPIB sweep; direct EMI-to-EMI flows without a bank intermediary are not accepted by Vanuatu banks and may trigger source-of-funds review.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No universal physical appearance mandate exists under Vanuatu law, but RBV-supervised commercial banks treat remote onboarding of non-resident ICs as enhanced-risk. As a practical matter, ANZ Vanuatu and BSP Vanuatu require at least one director or senior beneficial owner to join a video-conference call with a designated compliance officer; documents must be color-scanned and notarized, and a certified true copy of the passport must be endorsed by the registered agent. If no director can travel to Port Vila, banks prefer a bank-routed ISO 20022 identity verification via the presenting bank or an external transaction reference number; in-person interviews for non-resident directors remain the most reliable route since they eliminate the need for a Vanuatu trade-licence or substance addendum and materially compact approval to 5–10 business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The IC is newly incorporated by a VFSC-registered agent; all directors and shareholders are non-residents with no economic presence in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete corporate registry package: certificate of incorporation, certificate of current status / good standing (issued by VFSC), IC's memorandum and articles, certified beneficial-ownership register, notarized passport copies for all directors and beneficial owners, a 3-month proof of residential address, ICCS source of wealth statement, signed registered-agent confirmation describing the airport/large-port logistics SaaS business, and a two-year cash-flow forecast showing real operational expenditures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected first-year inflow exceeds the stated nominal share capital and originates from high-volume Stripe/PSP card settlements aggregated from numerous fleet operators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A board resolution approving an equity capital injection; audited or accountant-certified 3-year financial projections; executed SaaS master agreements and snapshot of at least five telematics/fleet dispatch purchase orders; API-based subscriber listing (anonymized counterparty location), PSP settlement history with payout UTRs; and a counterparty breakdown map tied to the 'Logistics Fleet Dispatch' scope. Banks will additionally ask for a certified list of beneficial owners and a copy of the International Company's annual return to VFSC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The account is expected to receive and disburse funds through a foreign fintech EMI or an offshore MSP (e.g., a non-bank card acquirer) rather than through SWIFT from named corporate clients.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A fully populated AML/KYC file for each intermediary: license certificate from its home authority, proof of no jurisdiction block for Vanuatu, merchant-of-record agreement, settlement and payout records including all GMT timestamps and originator information, and an executed 'No Funds from Crypto' policy. The file should include a compliance cover letter confirming that the EMI will run SWIFT GPIB transfers into a VU authorized dealer and that no unregulated third-party wallets are used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The IC uses its offshore account as a treasury sweep point, with a series of inbound 'capex injection' wires followed by outbound disbursements to cloud providers, contractors, and directors' fees.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A single, consistent waterfall document: signed investment/share subscription agreement with payment purposes, a register of capital contributions, invoices from cloud and telematics providers, contractor agreements with KYC for natural persons, and a board minute authorizing each director's fee. Any transaction above USD 50,000 should be supported by either an original counterparty contract or a bank export invoice, ensuring each leg remains traceable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use an SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home banking institution, addressed to the receiving Vanuatu authorized dealer (for example, ANZ's central treasury or BSP's Port Vila branch) with ISO 20022 purpose code 'INTC' or 'SHAR' (for equity subscription) and free-text field 70 'CAP_IC/01 - SHARE CAPITAL INCREASE - BENEFICIAL OWNER NAME' to avoid a generic transfer. If the receiving bank uses RBV reporting forms, complete the 'Capital Transfer / Source of Funds' declaration with the exact purpose: 'Equity injection for telematics logistics SaaS platform'. The 77B/Regulatory reporting field may state: 'REG/INIT/Fund from ABC BANK account in country X; no intermediary; not crypto; if a chain of correspondents is unavoidable, verify each intermediary with a full chain of title from the original bank to the beneficiary. On the receiving side, file a signed board resolution (approving issue of non-cash consideration shares if appropriate), updated register of members, and the IC's share certificate book entry to evidence the capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 (GPIB) is the primary clearing rail for all operational disbursements, using UETR-enabled messages and field 70s that state the purpose: 'SUPP - software & hosting costs', 'ROYL - patent/telematics royalty', or 'PCOM' for distribution commission. Where the disbursement funds a genuine physical fleet-hardware purchase (e.g., GNSS/GPS units, in-cab tablets), a commercial or standby letter of credit can be issued by the account-holding VU bank, confirmed by a top-tier correspondent, with sight drafts and inspection documents; for routine disbursements an irrevocable LC is over-engineered. For low-value subscription refunds to fleet operators, use SEPA instant/local real-time rails only when the counterparty is in an eligible jurisdiction; otherwise route through SWIFT with 'RFDN/REFND' purpose. It is essential to keep the reconciliation file on the ERP and forward it to the settlement bank to prevent returned wires under Article 4A.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright USD/VUV FX forwards up to 12 months, executed with an RBV-licensed authorized dealer, documented as a genuine hedge of SaaS subscription receipts.
USD/AUD or USD/NZD cross-currency swap (or FX swap) for liquidity matching existing two-current-account wires and supplier outlays, with a maximum tenor of 24 months and no leverage.

Vanilla FX options—USD call / VUV put—purchased from a local commercial bank to cap downside in the Vatu translation of USD-denominated revenue; no written options or speculative result triggers permitted.
Rolling FX forward overlay with a maximum aggregate notional equal to 80% of relevant quarterly invoiced receivables, renewing each month against a budget-documentation test.

Option locks and forward-start swaps are not available in the domestic Vanuatu market; an International Company may access them offshore only through an approved external bank, and the document set must evidence an in-force commercial exposure and board hedging mandate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), remitted through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date; VFSC renewal year ends on the anniversary of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late payment surcharge; if unpaid for 3 months after the due date, VFSC initiates administrative strike-off; struck-off company loses legal capacity and assets may escheat until restoration is ordered

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Verification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (register maintained at the registered office; inspectionable by VFSC on demand)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of the previous confirmation date, aligned with the annual renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-confirmation triggers agent due-diligence escalation and possible resignation; VFSC may impose administrative penalties and, on sustained default, strike-off under the Companies (Amendment) Act regime

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual AML/CFT Client Reassessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the VFSC AML regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at renewal and immediately upon any transfer of shares or change of director
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to complete reassessment may force agent resignation, causing loss of registered office and subsequent administrative strike-off; individual fines apply to officers for obstruction

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No separate tax holiday; Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from all income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax; no payroll tax applies to non-resident employees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for International Companies; annual compliance via VFSC Online Registry (Annual Renewal Record) with registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal due on the anniversary of incorporation unless VFSC approval for a changed month; no CIT statutory filing date applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name and VFSC registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name in the registry; no Vanuatu tax ID required for non-resident ICs without VAT registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC retains a licensed Vanuatu registered agent and a registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is mandatory for all ICs; the registered agent signs on behalf of non-resident directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of primary business (logistics fleet dispatch SaaS) for economic substance screening purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs must avoid indicating provision of services to VU residents; if the SaaS is supplied only abroad, VAT registration is unnecessary.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC filing triggers a rehabilitation fee, penalty of up to 10% of the annual license fee, and possible administrative strike-off after 6 months of delinquency.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has entered into no broad double-taxation treaty network; an IC paying dividends abroad has no Vanuatu WHT to deduct. Where a shareholder jurisdiction taxes foreign dividends, the shareholder should obtain a Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate only if the IC has become tax resident; otherwise the IC should provide a VFSC certificate of incorporation and a statement of tax-exempt status to the foreign tax authority.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates for royalties and interest are 0%; no treaty rates deviate because Vanuatu is not a party to an OECD Model income tax convention.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not cast in local currency because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax and operates no transfer-pricing statute for ICs; if the IC becomes a VAT-registered Vanuatu-resident enterprise, no Local File/Master File obligation exists under current domestic law.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu’s Economic Substance Regulations apply to ICs performing relevant activities (finance, leasing, headquarters, holding, distribution/service center, IP holding). A logistics fleet dispatch SaaS directed solely at non-resident customers is generally outside the listed relevant activities; however, any booking of revenue through a Vanuatu branch or related-party IP licensing could bring the operation into scope and require board meetings, physical office, expenditure, and local substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / trading with residents while claiming IC exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to invoice domestic residents for logistics software or dispatch services, generating local VAT and turnover obligations, while continuing to file no Vanuatu tax registers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of IC tax exemptions, retro-active VAT assessment at 12.5% (subject to current VU VAT law), customs-duty reassessment, plus administrative fines imposed by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may personally owe restitution for unlawful avoided VAT and be disqualified from management; culpable directors risk arrest and imprisonment under Vanuatu criminal law for filing false declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a bare nominee registered agent, no Vanuatu bank account, no board decisions, and no arm’s-length contracts for the SaaS products, solely to avoid reporting in the ultimate beneficial owner’s jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Striking-off of the IC, confinement to a VFSC enforcement docket, and monetary penalties for non-compliance with Economic Substance Regulations or International Companies Act record-keeping duties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court may pierce the corporate veil, imposing civil restitution and travel bans; directors or shareholder-beneficiaries can be ordered to compensate creditors and may face custodial sentences for fraudulent misuse of corporate register.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT failure and suspicious transaction non-reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Stripe or wire payments for logistics dispatch subscriptions without conducting beneficial-ownership or sanctions screening when the SaaS account is effectively used to launder proceeds of third-party crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Vanuatu’s Financial Transaction Reporting and Money Laundering acts, with fines, account seizure, and possible imprisonment (up to 20 years for aggravated money-laundering cases).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly fail to file suspicious transaction reports may incur criminal liability and be jailed; the court can order confiscation of personal assets and issue international travel bans pending extradition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting the registered agent, director identities, or economic-substance declarations to VFSC to conceal terminal beneficiaries' control of the logistics-tech IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Rescission of the certificate of incorporation, fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 (or other statutory amount), and mandatory disclosure to foreign competent authorities through international EOI requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution to defrauded third parties; deliberate forgery carries custodial penalty; travel bans are routinely sought during extradition and mutual legal assistance proceedings.
